owner_contracts.id: member.id is the source identity; never equate with target users.id.
owner_contracts.none: Reference only; no customer ownership and no staff roles. Archive rows remain only in encrypted source.
owner_contracts.memberId: row.memberId = member.id. NULL/0 -> unlinked; missing nonzero member -> orphan. No contact fallback.
owner_contracts.order:order_id: row.order_id = order.id AND order.memberId = member.id. Missing order -> orphan; guest order -> unlinked.
owner_contracts.order:orderId: row.orderId = order.id AND order.memberId = member.id. Missing order -> orphan; guest order -> unlinked.
owner_contracts.chat:chatId: row.chatId = chat.id (internal PK, not chat.chatId) AND chat.memberId = member.id. Missing parent/member -> orphan; NULL member -> unlinked.
owner_contracts.ticket:ticketId: row.ticketId = ticket.id AND ticket.memberId = member.id. No email ownership inference; ticket without member remains admin_full-only unlinked.
owner_contracts.pollAnswer:answer_id: row.answer_id = pollAnswer.id AND pollAnswer.memberId = member.id; missing parent/member -> orphan.
owner_contracts.task_links: Union task.itemType/itemId and task_linked_item WHERE taskId=task.id. Allowed typed links: member.id; order.id->memberId; chat.id->memberId; leadMagnetContact=LeadMagnetContact.id->memberId. Exactly one distinct existing member -> linked. Zero -> unlinked; multiple -> ambiguous. No name/phone/email matching.
owner_contracts.task:taskId: row.taskId = task.id; inherit independently resolved task owner only if exactly one. Missing task -> orphan. Ambiguous task and all its comments/links remain admin_full only.
owner_contracts.unlinked: No proven FK ownership. Retain history in admin_full-only unresolved registry with reason=no_source_owner; never attach by phone/name.
owner_contracts.unique_fingerprint_owner: fingerprint.id (or row.fingerprintId) = fingerprint_member.fingerprintId. Exactly one distinct existing memberId -> linked diagnostics; >1 -> ambiguous; zero -> anonymous_archive. Never recreate auth/session/trusted-browser state.
owner_contracts.unique_email: Exact LOWER(TRIM(row.email)), coupon uses emailBind, equals one unique LOWER(TRIM(member.email)). Only historical source membership; never merge canonical accounts or verify contact. No match -> unlinked, multiple -> ambiguous. Empty coupon binding is reference only.
owner_contracts.member_or_order: Resolve row.memberId and lottery_ticket.orderId / roulette_prize.buyAfterId -> order.memberId. Distinct valid member union must have size exactly one. Conflicting members -> ambiguous; none -> unlinked/orphan. Retain both original refs.
owner_contracts.order_cart: order.cartId = cart.id; resolve all matching order.memberId. Exactly one distinct member -> linked; >1 -> ambiguous; none -> unlinked. Never activate cart.
owner_contracts.typed_item_member: Only itemType=member AND itemId=member.id. Other item types are reference; unknown/missing member -> orphan. Never cast other IDs into member IDs.

unresolved_visibility: admin_full only; missing/ambiguous rows retain source table/id and reason
scalar_policy: Typed scalar only. Valid JSON object/array in a scalar field without an explicit structured contract is quarantined. Ordinary non-JSON text remains escaped text; never interpret HTML or PHP serialization. Redact embedded credential URLs. Unknown table/field/key fails export review rather than copying.

external_file_policy.source: only chat_msg.attachment.file.link, never URLs in text/caption/html
external_file_policy.dns: require all resolved addresses globally routable, pin validated address for transfer
external_file_policy.paths: no traversal/backslash/control characters; one inventory identity per source row and ordinal
external_file_policy.missing_file: retain visible reason and private original locator; never silently omit
external_file_policy.api: file ID only, authenticated download from private storage; never expose source locator

field_rules.fingerprint_userdata.value: Only name=email with syntactically valid address -> historical unverified contact; never identity matching or verification; unknown name/value format quarantined.
field_rules.order.extPayId: Provider transaction reference only: inspect scalar shape, bounded text, reject structured payload/credential URL; finance permission. Not proof of payment.
field_rules.order.extPayStatus: Source provider status only: bounded scalar; structured/unknown payload quarantined; finance permission. Not a new provider result.
field_rules.order.extPayName: Historical provider name only: bounded scalar; finance permission.
field_rules.order.extPayDateCompleted: Historical timestamp; no payment state transition.
field_rules.order_metrika.ym_clientId: Archive only: opaque analytics identifier; no recreation of cookies/session.
field_rules.call_history.recordFileName: Private inventory only; no provider API invocation; unknown storage locator quarantined.

timestamp_policy.timestamp: UTC instant, retain raw source value
timestamp_policy.datetime: Europe/Moscow local wall time; explicit conversion to UTC
timestamp_policy.epoch_integer: Unix UTC seconds only for declared fields
timestamp_policy.birth_date: Convert source TIMESTAMP instant to Europe/Moscow calendar date
timestamp_policy.zero_or_invalid_date: null normalized date plus visible issue; preserve raw string
